name: fe-architectures
description: Six frontend architectures, each a standalone React project + a hub page to browse them

scripts.setup: npm run build --prefix 05-jamstack && npm run build --prefix 06-pwa
scripts.dev: concurrently -n hub,mpa,spa,ssr,products,cart,shell,jam,pwa -c cyan,green,yellow,blue,magenta,magenta,magenta,gray,white "node hub/server.js" "npm run dev --prefix 01-mpa" "npm run dev --prefix 02-spa" "npm run dev --prefix 03-ssr-hybrid" "npm run dev --prefix 04-micro-frontends/remote-products" "npm run dev --prefix 04-micro-frontends/remote-cart" "npm run dev --prefix 04-micro-frontends/shell" "npm run start --prefix 05-jamstack" "npm run preview --prefix 06-pwa"
